correctness.rationale: On balanced events, the precise joint four-cell probabilities and centered rank-one identities yield a skew rank-two kernel. Conditional Jensen contraction plus pairwise mean removal reduce every real/complex Lp norm exactly to a two-dimensional offdiagonal map; its two coefficient magnitudes yield the stated norm including endpoints. The logarithmic derivative is a signed quadratic with a unique root inside (0,1). At c=0 or |c|=1 the projections commute and require separate treatment. The limits and constants follow directly. The code passed 2612 rational and numerical consistency assertions.

value.rationale: The all-p exact operator-norm law for a natural two-event information-commutator gives a new explicit sharp correlation envelope, the complete exponent-dependent optimizer, and a sharp boundary-stability dichotomy. As balanced event partitions converge in L2 they fail dramatically to commute in endpoint operator norm, approaching the universal 2 bound, whereas interior norms decay at a precise exponent. This is a substantive canonical boundary phenomenon, not an arbitrary finite-table computation.
